subject: Prepare to move to R v2.6.0

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Prepare to move to R v2.6.0
parts:
Hi,

I just want to let you know that there is/will be low-level
differences between upcoming R v2.6.0 (release date October 3, 2007)
and current R v2.5.1 that makes it very hard to provide packages that
will install on both. Thus, we R v2.6.0 will be official, all of
Bioconductor will move to R v2.6.0, and so is aroma.affymetrix likely
to do. So, prepare yourself and/or your sysadms to move to R v2.6.0.

Cheers

Henrik
